title: Sable and the Inheritance
author: Ines Dunmore
blurb: Cyrus Coldharbour, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
